column1: # BridgesLLM Portal toolctl identity manifest v1
# Append-only ledger of installer/tools/bridgesllm-toolctl.py, which the
# template run. Each row names the exact toolctl bytes one signed build
# changes between signed builds of one version, so a version may have several
# rows. Do not rewrite or delete a row: a host keeps the toolctl it was given
# until its next update, and that update must still admit it. Append the next
# row before a signed build ships a changed toolctl, and when the installer
# VERSION changes (the same bytes under the new version if toolctl did not
# change). The installer prune guard set PORTAL_TOOLCTL_RELEASES must list
